newsitem.title: DUBAI: Egyptian president Mubarak arrives in Abu Dhabi.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian president Mubarak arrives in Abu Dhabi.

text.p: Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak arrived in Abu Dhabi on Friday for a two-day visit to the United Arab Emirates (UAE), the official WAM news agency said.

Mubarak was accompanied by senior officials including Foreign Minister Amr Moussa on the visit to congratulate UAE President Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan on his recovery from an operation, the agency said.
Sheikh Zaid, 78, returned home to a jubilant welcome on Wednesday after neck surgery in the United States.
